title: Erroneous Load Reversal Terms by Package — Paystride Payroll Card Program
content:
For erroneous payroll loads, each package of the Paystride Payroll Card Program states the window in business days after the load posted within which a reversal may be requested, the reasons for which a load may be reversed, the fee per reversal request, and whether that fee is charged when nothing could be recovered.

| Package | Request window (business days after the load posted) | Reasons accepted | Fee per reversal request (USD) | Fee charged when nothing is recovered |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Paycard Program Essential | 5 | duplicate load; wrong amount; wrong worker | 15.00 | yes |
| Paystride Paycard Program Standard | 5 | duplicate load; wrong amount; wrong worker | 15.00 | yes |
| Paystride Paycard Program Select | 5 | duplicate load; wrong amount; wrong worker | 12.50 | yes |
| Paystride Paycard Program Advantage | 5 | duplicate load; wrong amount; wrong worker | 10.00 | yes |
| Paystride Paycard Program Premier | 5 | duplicate load; wrong amount; wrong worker | 7.50 | no |
| Paystride Paycard Program Elite | 5 | duplicate load; wrong amount; wrong worker | 0.00 | no |

### Reading the terms

- The window and the reasons are the same in every package; the fee and its treatment on a request that recovers nothing differ.
- Under the Premier package a request that recovers nothing carries no fee, while one that recovers any amount carries 7.50.
- Under the Elite package no reversal fee is charged in either case.

Hypothetical comparison: two requests that each recover nothing, one under the Select package and one under the Premier package, carry 12.50 and nothing respectively.
